target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

No linked issue; this is a team-approved Android PR.

Android chat did not give users a discoverable way to start a fresh conversation or discover Gateway-backed slash commands from the composer. Earlier PR iterations also had split session-control behavior across Android chat surfaces: the main chat screen used guarded New Chat handling, while the sheet composer could still route `/new` through normal chat send.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds Android New Chat controls backed by Gateway `sessions.create`, Gateway-backed slash command discovery while typing `/`, command prefix filtering by name or text alias, and guarded session-control handling across the main chat screen and ChatSheet/ChatComposer. New Chat is disabled while active or queued chat work makes a session switch unsafe; delayed `sessions.create` responses are ignored if the user has moved to a different session; selected or typed `/new` routes through the guarded Android New Chat path instead of `chat.send`; and admin-gated slash commands Android cannot safely execute are filtered or disabled instead of requiring Android to request `operator.admin`.

Scope boundaries: Android does not request or persist `operator.admin`, this PR does not add a permanent slash button in the composer, and admin-gated reset execution is not part of the PR claim.

## User Impact

Android users can start fresh chat sessions from the header `+` control and use `/` to discover supported chat commands without memorizing command names. `/new` behaves consistently from the reachable Android composer surfaces, uses the same guarded session-creation path, and avoids sending `/new` as a normal chat message. Unsupported admin-gated entries are not presented as executable Android actions.

## Evidence

Focused proof after the native i18n resync and MockWebServer shutdown lifecycle patch:

```bash
git diff --check
pnpm native:i18n:check
cd apps/android
./gradlew --no-daemon --build-cache :app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.gateway.GatewaySessionInvokeTest.eventsAreDispatchedInWebSocketFrameOrder --console=plain --stacktrace
```

Results:

- `git diff --check`: passed.
- `pnpm native:i18n:check`: passed, `entries=2363`, `changed=false`.
- `GatewaySessionInvokeTest.eventsAreDispatchedInWebSocketFrameOrder`: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m 57s`; 30 actionable tasks, 2 executed and 28 up-to-date.

Focused proof after the ChatSheet guarded `/new` patch:

```bash
cd apps/android
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest --console=plain --stacktrace
```

Result: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m 22s` with 30 actionable tasks and 5 executed.

Additional proof already run on this PR branch before the final ChatSheet route repair:

```bash
git diff --check
pnpm native:i18n:check
cd apps/android
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest --console=plain --stacktrace
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assemblePlayDebug --console=plain --stacktrace
```

Results:

- `git diff --check`: passed.
- `pnpm native:i18n:check`: passed, `entries=2363`, `changed=false`.
- Focused Android unit tests for command controls and controller command handling: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`.
- `:app:assemblePlayDebug`: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`.

Focused Android coverage locks:

- Header New Chat creates unique sessions instead of reusing the `"New chat"` label.
- New Chat is gated while active, streaming, loading, queued, or pending run state makes a session switch unsafe.
- Stale `sessions.create` responses are ignored after session or run-state changes.
- Selected or typed `/new` routes through the guarded Android New Chat path from the main chat screen.
- Selected or typed `/new` routes through the guarded Android New Chat path from ChatSheet/ChatComposer.
- ChatSheet/ChatComposer does not send `/new` through normal `chat.send`.
- Admin-gated slash commands are filtered or disabled unless Android has a safe local action and permission path.
- Gateway session WebSocket frame dispatch test now shuts down MockWebServer cleanly after dispatching the expected events.

Visible Android emulator proof links:

Header `+` creates a unique new chat session:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15d788e5-60a9-4c4f-bef9-043800ad61d4

`/new` starts a new session:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3bb3428-a7fb-44d3-81c9-8cf0c49e2c65

Slash command filtering:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b00ddccb-e6d7-4b1f-9df4-03a55382b2c3

Not retested with new video after the final ChatSheet patch: full Android release build matrix, physical-device pairing, and refreshed visual recording of the ChatSheet surface. The final ChatSheet `/new` route and MockWebServer lifecycle fix are covered by the focused Android regression tests above.
